content.text:
I wrote the migrated file to `out/module.ts`. The size check printed 529 bytes (min+gzip) with 127 bytes of own code. I didn't compare the output against lodash, because lodash isn't installed here, so I reasoned from the es-toolkit source instead.

`tsc` reports no errors for `out/module.ts`. The only errors are in the original `src/module.ts`, which still imports lodash.

- **`applyPatch`:** `es-toolkit`'s `merge` mutates `base` and merges arrays by index, like lodash. `null` values are assigned in both. For the allowed inputs it behaves the same.
- **`toTitle`:** `es-toolkit`'s `startCase` lowercases the rest of each word, so `"ABC"` would become `"Abc"`, where lodash gives `"ABC"`. I used `words(key).map(upperFirst).join(' ')` instead. The lodash-faithful `es-toolkit/compat` `startCase` would also work but bundles to 1962 bytes, so I didn't use it.
- **`toLookup`:** `es-toolkit` has no `fromPairs`, so I used `zipObject` on the two columns. Duplicate keys resolve to the last value, as in lodash.

No lodash import remains. Row, Config and the exported signatures are unchanged.
